newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak 1995 GDP revised down to 6.8pct from 7.4pct.
newsitem.headline: Slovak 1995 GDP revised down to 6.8pct from 7.4pct.

text.p: The Slovak Statistical Bureau (SUSR) said on Wednesday it revised down 1995 real GDP growth to 6.8 percent from a previously reported 7.4 percent.

SUSR said the change was due to revised figures from the 1995 "balance of exports and imports of goods and services" to a surplus of 9.4 billion crowns ($282.2 million) from a previous surplus of 16.9 billion.

"This change influenced 1995 GDP, which decreased to 515.1 billion crowns from 518 billion in current prices," SUSR said. -- Peter Javurek, Bratislava Newsroom, 421-7-521-8402 ($ = 33.31 Slovak Crowns)
